name: vuesp.DDS6619
summary: DDS6619 single-phase energy meter with voltage, current, power and energy readings.
description:
## Vuesp DDS6619

ESP32-C3 project for the DDS6619 single-phase energy meter. The meter is polled over Modbus RTU on `Serial1` at 9600 8N1 and exposes voltage, current, active power, frequency and active, positive, reverse and reactive energy.

The dashboard shows live meter values, while the standard Vuesp web UI provides Wi-Fi setup, GPIO, ScriptRunner, LittleFS and OTA updates.
